runner.clock_states: two stable states for short kernels; absolute numbers are not portable

measurement.warm: 10 warmup launches, 100 timed iterations per round
measurement.order: interleaved A/B, order rotated every round
measurement.noise: warm: one 32 ns tick; cold: overlapping ranges and medians within 1.5 percent

sources.S1: the main matrix (43 shapes in this CSV; h_mm_128 is S3)

commands.note: The curated CSV is the redistributable evidence. compare.py covers the 15 open-set names by default; pass --problems with package paths for generated and holdout shapes.
commands.baseline: the cleanup column is the frozen pre-optimization measurement of this compiler from the same session; the baseline compiler is not part of this release
